top_candidate: LIDAR-01 — Cross-scale slope-aware template and line-evidence consensus (proposal only; not generated or tested).
hypothesis: At native resolution, a slope-aware scarplet-template fit reinforced by coherent Steger sub-pixel ridge/valley positions and Frangi line responses persistent across 2, 5, 10, and 20 m scales may identify surface scarps on faults absent from the public catalogue. Aggregate scarp fraction, SNR-weighted amplitude, orientation coherence, and dominant strike to 100 m. This is untested.
mechanism: A subdued fault scarp omitted from the catalogue may retain a cross-profile step and line response across neighboring physical scales. Requiring agreement among slope-aware profile shape, sub-pixel line location, and multiscale Hessian evidence may distinguish persistent fault scarps from isolated edges. No performance inference follows from this physical rationale.
non_fault_mimic: A fluvial terrace riser; other named mimics include road/canal embankments, channel banks, landslide headscarps, mine benches, field edges, and paleo-shorelines.
